name: feature
description: Full product workflow for a user-visible feature. Gates run in charter order; every step is a ticket so progress % reflects real completion.

steps.title: PMF check: {title}
steps.body: Name the user and trigger scenario. keep/kill/reshape verdict on this ticket before anything builds.

steps.title: Design pass: {title}
steps.body: Interaction quality pass on the affected surface. Accept/return verdict with actionable fixes.

steps.title: Contract review: {title}
steps.body: Review the shape: contracts, failure modes, edges. No verdict without a failure-mode list.

steps.title: Build: {title}
steps.body: Implement in a sandbox lane. Completion comment must carry test counts and evidence.

steps.title: Measure: {title}
steps.body: Define and capture the metric that proves it works. Attach evidence to this ticket.

steps.title: Accept: {title}
steps.body: Reviewer != builder. Accept or return with specific gaps. The owner holds final say.
